run_explorer_ablation_grid: run the explorer function to launch an ablation study grid across seeds and audio datasets using ClipExplorer
configure_slurm_resources: configure slurm resources with launcher.slurm_ setting gpus, memory per gpu, and partition for the experiment grid
bind_model_config: bind model configuration options like clip_conv model and batch size using launcher.bind_ in the explorer function
create_job_array_experiments: create a job array with launcher.job_array to iterate over seed and dataset combinations using itertools.product
run_simpleconv_ablation: run simpleconv ablation experiments by toggling merger, dropout, glu, gelu, skip, complex_out, and subject_layers options
